params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the office's report; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P1
Summary: Since #1114 AutoConnect gets at most 10 seconds inside a chassis lookup. That cuts off almost half of its answers, and from the release on every AutoConnect lookup on production has come back empty, so sheets get VWE's fields only.

## What happened

Read on production on 25 November. The figures are the seconds from VWE's row to AutoConnect's row of the same vehicle, over the 355 answers kept in the 60 days before 24 November:

| seconds | answers |
|---|---|
| up to 5 | 70 |
| 6 to 10 | 119 |
| 11 to 20 | 118 |
| over 20 | 48 |

- 166 of 355 answers came after more than 10 seconds.
- Since the release of 24 November 15:13, all 8 AutoConnect lookups kept `"0"` (cURL's `false`). They cover 5 chassis numbers from at least two garages.
- For ZAC5JACL5SJL91514, the empty rows sit 10 to 11 seconds after VWE's row.

## Proposed fix

Give AutoConnect up to 20 of the lookup's 24 seconds. With 20 seconds, about six answers in seven arrive within the request. `KeepAutoConnectAnswer` (#1125) fetches the rest.
params.title: Every AutoConnect lookup comes back empty since AutoConnect got 10 seconds
